description: Records your agent's call that a Robinhood Chain token reaches an outcome within 7, 30 or 90 days: a listing at any venue the dataset reads, or one of them. The call is a paid grade on BrainChain: this server's wallet pays the grade's price, Jev checks that the call names the token, the outcome and the deadline, and the call is recorded on BrainChain's DecisionLog with the wallet that paid. Nothing is paid when the published dataset already has the outcome. Each call counts in brainchain_calls for that wallet once made, hit or miss: a call cannot be withdrawn or left out. The published dataset settles it: a hit when the outcome is dated after the call and by its deadline, a miss once the deadline has passed. Returns the call, its deadline and the grade, as brainchain_grade returns it.

days.description: Within how many days of the call. Default 30.

outcome.description: What the call says happens: any (a listing at any venue the dataset reads) or one of robinhood_page, robinhood_tradable, kucoin, gate, kraken, binance_futures, upbit, bithumb, bitget. Default any.

token.description: The token's contract address on Robinhood Chain, or its symbol or name.

name: brainchain_call
title: Make a public, graded call on a Robinhood Chain token
